explication: Agentic.nvim is a Neovim chat interface for ACP-compatible AI agents. The user opens a chat, starts or restores a provider-managed session, sends prompts with optional editor context, handles tool permissions, and views responses and diffs in the chat UI. The README documents provider/model/mode switching, image and file context, slash commands, multiple sessions, and session portability. The tree supports the component paths below, but the sampled source is only a standalone ACP test script, so most internal calls are unverified and are shown as dashed links without evidence paths.
